title: One recorded baseline run (or a replayed-dispatch set) of the V1 loop on hello-loop
description: tools/baseline/summarize.py validates results/*.json against this file with a small built-in checker (type, enum, required, properties, items, minimum, pattern, const). Extra properties are allowed everywhere. Fill results/TEMPLATE.json; name the copy results/<run_id>.json.

kind.description: run = one end-to-end V1 run; replay = dispatches of one agent type re-run in isolation (the '1 run + 20 replays' alternative)

status.description: kind=run only. completed = all three items reached done. v1_cannot_finish = the loop could not finish even with rescues (fires the kill-criteria branch). aborted = stopped for a reason unrelated to V1 (machine, quota); not counted as evidence either way

claude_version.description: output of `claude --version`, typed by the human

cloud_credentials.description: true if any cloud credential was reachable (the baseline requires false)

wall_time_min.description: start of /orchestrate to the last item done (or the stop), minutes, including time spent waiting for the human

active_time_min.description: wall time minus checkpoint waits and idle time, if known

spend_usd.description: from the session cost display; null if not observable

tool_calls.description: the loop's own tally or the observation log's PreToolUse count

checkpoint_approvals.description: designed pauses the human approved; not rescues

rescues.description: Every time the human did something the loop should have done or decided for itself. Checkpoint approvals are not rescues.

checked.description: the held-out checks were run on the final tree

dispatches.description: agent type -> number of dispatches in the run (from the observation log, reconciled by the human)

source_run.description: kind=replay only: the run the dispatch inputs were taken from
